brief.headline: Novoskelvatoe seized near Pokrovsk; Rybar slams fuel-strike coordination
brief.lead: Pro-Kremlin channels amplified a strong frontline day—claimed capture of Novoskelvatoe and a bridgehead west of the Gaichur river toward Pokrovsk—while Rybar broke ranks to call Russia's strikes on Ukrainian fuel infrastructure poorly coordinated and insufficient. Sentiment on the frontline surged, but a Ukrainian strike on a WW2 memorial museum in Rostov drew angry coverage.

developments.title: Claimed capture of Novoskelvatoe, bridgehead toward Pokrovsk
developments.body: Multiple channels claimed Russia's Vostok grouping liberated Novoskelvatoe and established a bridgehead west of the Gaichur river, framing it as a springboard for the Pokrovsk advance in the Dnipropetrovsk direction. Unconfirmed; channel-sourced, not attributed to MoD.

developments.title: Rybar criticizes Russia's own fuel-strike campaign as inadequate
developments.body: In a notable self-critical thread, Rybar argued strikes on Ukrainian fuel bases in Dnipropetrovsk were insufficient and poorly coordinated, and that Russia has not destroyed southern fuel infrastructure, while separately arguing 22 Odesa oil depots could cripple Ukrainian logistics if targeted.

developments.title: Claimed destruction of two MiG-29s at Voznesensk airfield
developments.body: Several channels claimed Russian Shahed/Geran loitering munitions destroyed two Ukrainian MiG-29 fighters, plus fuel trucks and personnel, at Voznesensk airfield in Mykolaiv region. Unconfirmed.

developments.title: Ukrainian strike on Rostov WW2 memorial museum drives outrage
developments.body: Channels reported a Ukrainian drone strike on the Sambekskie Heights military museum in Rostov region during a festival, damaging the WW2 memorial complex and injuring twelve, used to frame Ukraine as targeting civilian/heritage sites.

developments.title: Leopard tank claimed destroyed near Konstantinovka by FPV drones
developments.body: Multiple channels claimed coordinated FPV drone strikes destroyed a camouflaged German Leopard tank near Konstantinovka, amid reported Russian clearing operations there. Unconfirmed.

developments.title: Ukraine reports mass drone attack; Volgograd factory hit
developments.body: Channels relayed Russian claims of 175 drones destroyed overnight, while acknowledging a strike hit a Volgograd factory and the Titan-Barricades missile-systems plant; Krasnodar warned of further threats. MoD-sourced count, unconfirmed.

narrative_watch.title: Self-criticism on strike coordination
narrative_watch.body: Rybar's insistence that Russia's fuel-infrastructure strikes are insufficient and uncoordinated signals a milblogger frame pressuring command for a more systematic strike campaign against Ukrainian logistics.

narrative_watch.title: Ukraine attacks heritage/civilians framing
narrative_watch.body: Coverage of the Rostov museum and a Bryansk civilian vehicle strike sustains the frame of Ukraine deliberately targeting memorials and non-combatants.

narrative_watch.title: Domestic authorities spreading disinformation
narrative_watch.body: Arkhangel Spetsnaza accused Russian officials of wrongly telling citizens drones launch from Russian soil, an unusual jab at government competence.

mood_lines.text: Sharply positive on claimed Novoskelvatoe capture, Konstantinovka clearing and Leopard kills; near-uniform triumphalism across channels (net +95).
Still net positive but cooled sharply as Rybar publicly criticized fuel-strike coordination, tempering the usual celebration of deep strikes.
Negative, driven by anger over the Rostov museum strike, Bryansk civilian death, and factory hits in Volgograd.
Sharply negative on Swedish coast-guard militarization, Ukrainian missile plans against Moscow, and opaque Putin-Lukashenko talks.
Mixed: POW release framed positively, but complaints over British Council-accredited tourism and calls for collective sacrifice.
Fully negative but low-volume: two posts faulting authorities over drone messaging and museum-funding publicity.

flag_texts.title: Frontline sentiment jumps +33 to net +95
flag_texts.body: Near-unanimous positive posting driven by the claimed capture of Novoskelvatoe, a Gaichur bridgehead toward Pokrovsk, and repeated Leopard/howitzer/locomotive kill claims.

flag_texts.title: Strikes on Ukraine drops 39 points to net +50
flag_texts.body: Rybar's multi-post critique calling fuel-infrastructure strikes insufficient and poorly coordinated pulled an otherwise upbeat topic down despite MiG-29 and substation strike claims.

flag_texts.title: West & NATO falls 46 points to net -67
flag_texts.body: Sentiment soured on Sweden's coast-guard militarization to 2030, Ukraine's stated ballistic-missile plans against Moscow and St. Petersburg, and the unusually secretive Putin-Lukashenko meeting.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation rumours and Putin criticism absent
flag_texts.body: No posts on mobilisation rumours or direct criticism of Putin; the day's criticism was limited to two posts targeting authorities' drone messaging and museum funding.
